title: Exercise CCP2 wire through native receive paths
description:
Scope: focused native-peer exchange tests reusing /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/python/tests/sim/test_cross_impl_interop.py, production test adapters under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/rust/lichen-node/tests/, and /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/lichen/tests/l2_dispatch/ where suitable. Feed raw signed CCP2 bytes plus clock/radio events into real Python/Rust/C receive and adoption paths, reporting observable state and TX actions. Minimal adapters are permitted; a new daemon/protocol framework is not required. Expected bytes and transitions come from the independent corpus, never from a producer under test.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing peer harnesses and compile small adapters only when necessary. Stub peripheral event delivery, not production decisions or oracle results; keep all execution offline without opening device ports.
acceptance_criteria: Applicable cross-language directions process valid objects and reject frozen malformed, mixed-version, signature, owner/context and freshness cases at actual receive boundaries. Rejected frames do not mutate adopted state or trigger radio TX. Adapters invoke production parsing/authentication/adoption rather than mocked decisions. Exact case IDs, raw inputs, observable outcomes, commands and revisions are captured; successful cross-language round trips alone do not satisfy the gate.
